name: Menon Bearings Ltd
title: Menon Bearings Ltd-$ - 523828 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management guides ~25% annual growth toward INR500 crore by FY28 and 20-22% EBITDA margin, with utilisation rising (Bi-Metal 85%, Alkop 65%) but no hard capacity expansion beyond modest capex of about INR35 crore over two years.

utilisation.quote: we are up to the production targets and capacity utilization to the extent of 85% in Bi-Metal

capex.quote: Planned CapEx for Menon Bearings, it is a bearing division, it is a Bi-Metal division, INR25 crores for next two years.

triggers.label: Bi-Metal utilisation 85%
triggers.quote: capacity utilization to the extent of 85% in Bi-Metal

triggers.label: Raw material pass-through quarterly
triggers.quote: we were successful in passing on that burden of raw material to the customers to the larger extent

triggers.label: Debtor turnover above 180 days
triggers.quote: the total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days

triggers.label: INR500 cr revenue by FY28 target
triggers.quote: we will take all -out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28

guidance.quote: it should be about between 20 % to 22% during next two years
we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years
Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.
we should be able to reach asset turnover of 2. By '28, we should be reaching that 100%.

guidance.value: more than INR120 crore in next 2 years
guidance.quote: we can reach more than INR120 crores in next 2 years so far as Alkop is concerned

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue INR275 crore then INR290 crore
prior_guidance_check.quote: We had given a figure of INR 275 crore for this year that we have already achieved.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Dynamometer delivery by last year August
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are 100% sure that it will be completed by August

red_flags.label: Debtors over 180 days, export receivables stretched
red_flags.quote: the total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days

red_flags.label: Repeated delayed commissioning of dynamometer
red_flags.quote: we actually ordered this machine or testing machine for (from) two other manufacturers but unfortunately they could not complete

red_flags.label: Interest expense rising, working capital strain
red_flags.quote: The one thing which is sticking out is the high interest expenses.

evasions.quote: Truly speaking, we are not bifurcating order book solution into auto and HCV/LCV.
